ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels occupying approximately 85% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixels localized at distal margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central and proximal regions defined by a contiguous low-intensity mask. High-intensity mottling is localized on the upper distal quadrant of the left lobe and more extensively on the upper distal quadrant of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central notch with an approximate pixel angle of 45 degrees and moderate depth relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the entire continuous trailing edge; notable irregular peaks detected on the medial section of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory along the trailing edge sweeping upward to pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-intensity punctate clusters (likely barnacle scars) scattered across the lower-central dark field and near the inferior fluke base.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical and diagonal linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) detected on the medial section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Fragmented and irregular tissue profile at the distal tips of both lobes; distinct cluster of high-contrast markings at the fluke base near the water line.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetrical wear pattern on the distal tips, with the right tip showing more significant erosion and fragmentation than the left.
